rootCause: Commander negated-flag key inversion. `.option('--no-source-pair')` stores the value under the POSITIVE camelCase key `sourcePair` (true by default, false when the flag is passed) and never creates a `noSourcePair` key. `buildInput` (packages/cli/src/commands/test-craft.ts:86) read `opts.noSourcePair === true`, which is `undefined` on every path, so `input.sourcePair` was never set and the engine's `input.sourcePair !== false` guard (packages/cli/src/test-craft/index.ts:153 and :198) always resolved to enabled. The documented flag was inert from the command's introduction in b8d97b0af.
fix: Command layer only. Renamed `TestCraftCliOptions.noSourcePair?: boolean` to `sourcePair?: boolean` so the interface describes the object Commander actually produces, and changed the read to `if (opts.sourcePair === false) input.sourcePair = false;` — the established repo idiom (install.ts:459, mcp.ts:243, adoption.ts:370, recommend.ts:138, predict.ts:177). The engine's `input.sourcePair` contract is unchanged.

evidence.beforeFix: packages/cli/tests/commands/test-craft-command.test.ts — 1 failed | 35 passed (36) [file size at the time of the fix; one redundant test was removed in review round 2, so the committed file is 35]. AssertionError: expected undefined to be false, at `expect(capturedInput().sourcePair).toBe(false)`.
evidence.afterFix: packages/cli/tests/commands/test-craft-command.test.ts — 36 passed (36) at the time of the fix. The committed file is 35 passed (35): review round 2 removed the redundant 'leaves source pairing enabled when --no-source-pair is omitted' test.
evidence.revertAndFail: Fix temporarily reverted to `opts.noSourcePair === true`; the regression test failed again with the identical AssertionError, then passed on restore.
evidence.wider: packages/cli tests/commands/ + tests/test-craft/ — 171 files, 2316 tests, all passed against the committed tree (2317 before review round 2 removed the redundant test). `tsc --noEmit` on packages/cli clean.
evidence.commanderProbe: commander 12.1.0 probed directly: with --no-source-pair -> {"sourcePair":false} (noSourcePair undefined); without the flag -> {"sourcePair":true}.
evidence.overCorrectionProbe: Verified the default-path guard is not lost by dropping the dedicated flag-omitted test. `buildInput` was temporarily changed to the naive over-correction `if (opts.sourcePair !== undefined) input.sourcePair = opts.sourcePair;`; the surviving 'omits unsupplied flags from the input entirely' test failed with `AssertionError: expected [ 'path', 'sourcePair' ] to deeply equal [ 'path' ]`, then passed again on restore. 35 passed (35) after restore.

assumptions: Kept the engine's `input.sourcePair` contract as-is (optional boolean, pairing disabled only on an explicit `false`). The defect is in the command layer's option read, not the engine — both engine call sites already agree and are correct, so changing the engine would be the larger and riskier edit.

INVERTED AN EXISTING PINNING TEST. `packages/cli/tests/commands/test-craft-command.test.ts` previously carried 'does not reach the engine with --no-source-pair (characterizes a live defect)', which asserted `expect(capturedInput()).not.toHaveProperty('sourcePair')` and PASSED against the broken code. It was written to fail by design the moment the flag was wired correctly. It is now 'disables source pairing at the engine when --no-source-pair is passed' and asserts `sourcePair === false`. A previously-passing assertion has changed meaning; this is deliberate, not a silent rewrite.

Asserted the concrete value `sourcePair === false` rather than mere property presence, because the engine disables pairing only on a literal `false` (`input.sourcePair !== false`) — a property present with any other value would still leave pairing on, so presence alone would be a weaker guard than the contract requires.

Renamed the interface field rather than translating at the boundary. `recommend.ts` and `predict.ts` keep a `noX` field on their own internal options type and map from `opts.x === false`; here `TestCraftCliOptions` IS the Commander opts shape, so the field itself had to be renamed to stay honest.

Did NOT add a separate default-path (flag-omitted) test. Commander defaults the negated key to `true`, so a fix that forwarded the default would set `sourcePair: true` on the input — but the pre-existing 'omits unsupplied flags from the input entirely' test already asserts the whole input shape (`Object.keys(input)` equals `['path']`) for that exact invocation, so it catches the over-correction with a strictly stronger assertion. A dedicated `not.toHaveProperty('sourcePair')` test would be subsumed by it and would pass against the pre-fix code, so it would document a guard it does not provide. The existing test's comment was extended to name the #1882 default path instead.

Left the flag's user-facing declaration and help text unchanged, so `pnpm run generate-docs` produced no diff in docs/reference/cli-commands.md. The documentation was never wrong — the code was. No doc change is part of this fix.

SCOPE: fixed only `--no-source-pair` in packages/cli/src/commands/test-craft.ts. The identical Commander inversion in design-pipeline.ts:62-63 (issue #1881, separately owned) and dashboard.ts:121 (`opts.noOpen` read at :121, `--no-open` declared at :132, no normalizing `.action()` — filed as #1956) was deliberately NOT touched and is reported separately. fleet/budget-check.ts is NOT an instance: its `.action()` at :219 normalizes `noRefresh: opts.refresh === false` before calling the separately-exported `runBudgetCheck()`, so the `opts.noRefresh` read at :170 receives an already-normalized object. It is one of four sites using the normalize-in-`.action()` idiom (the others are recommend.ts:138, predict.ts:177, agent/review.ts:179), alongside five that read the positive key directly (install.ts:459, mcp.ts:243, adoption.ts:370, distortion.ts:155, fix-drift.ts:228).
